Add a PDF download to existing Quarto books

Source: R/create_book.R
add_pdf_download.Rd

Adds a PDF format to the _quarto.yml of existing books and a "Download PDF" icon to the sidebar of their HTML version (book: downloads: [pdf]). The other fields of the _quarto.yml are kept. Render then all the formats with render_book(output_format = "all"): the icon links to the PDF of the output folder.

Usage

add_pdf_download(
  dirname_reports,
  path_reports = "reports",
  format = c("typst", "pdf"),
  template = NULL,
  path = NULL
)

Arguments

dirname_reports

Character vector of book folder names, relative to path_reports.

path_reports

Folder in which the report folders are created.

format

PDF engine: "typst" (the default, bundled with Quarto) or "pdf" (LaTeX).

template

Optional template whose typst.yml / pdf.yml styles the PDF (e.g. "inrae"). Its files missing from the book (e.g. inrae.typ, _brand.yml) are copied; existing files are not overwritten. NULL uses a plain style (table of contents, numbered sections, A4).

path

Deprecated, use path_reports.

Value

The paths of the book folders, invisibly.

Details

Interactive content (leaflet, plotly, DT, ...) has no PDF rendering: show it only in the HTML with ::: {.content-visible when-format="html"} and give a static version for the PDF.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile()
dir.create(tmp)
create_book(
  "rapport", path_reports = tmp, template = "inrae", author = "Kevin"
)
#> Book(s) created: rapport
add_pdf_download("rapport", path_reports = tmp, template = "inrae")
#> PDF download added to: rapport
cat(readLines(file.path(tmp, "rapport", "_quarto.yml")), sep = "\n")
#> project:
#>   type: book
#>   output-dir: _book
#> book:
#>   title: rapport
#>   subtitle: Sous-titre du rapport
#>   date: today
#>   date-format: long
#>   chapters:
#>   - index.qmd
#>   favicon: images/favicon-inrae.png
#>   sidebar:
#>     logo: images/logo-inrae.png
#>     style: docked
#>   page-footer:
#>     left: INRAE
#>     right: Rapport rédigé avec [Quarto](https://quarto.org)
#>   author:
#>   - Kevin
#>   downloads:
#>   - pdf
#> bibliography: references.bib
#> link-citations: true
#> lang: fr
#> format:
#>   html:
#>     theme:
#>     - cosmo
#>     - inrae-charte.scss
#>     - inrae.scss
#>     toc: true
#>     number-sections: true
#>     reference-location: margin
#>     citation-location: document
#>   typst:
#>     toc: true
#>     number-sections: true
#>     papersize: a4
#>     include-in-header: inrae.typ
